correctness.rationale: Independently expanded the five quadratic Lie derivatives using exact SymPy polynomial arithmetic and inspected packaged verify.py at its pinned blob: for P=xyzuv, L(x²/2)=a x²−P and L(y²/2)=−b y²+P, similarly z,u,v. Invariance of compactly supported μ makes every average Lie derivative zero, so a E[x²]=b E[y²]=c E[z²]=d E[u²]=e E[v²]=E[P]. With e<0 the common nonnegative/nonpositive value must vanish and all coordinates vanish, hence δ_0. With e=0 x,y,z,u vanish and v arbitrary on a fixed equilibrium line; all laws on this line are invariant. With e>0, the positive common value yields weighted RMS ratios. The claim does not exclude unbounded or nonrecurrent solutions.
